    How it works
    Music

    Search at the top, or click a cover to play it. + adds a song to Up next; Up next plays first, then Autoplay carries on with the list on the wall.

    All, ★ Carino and Lists pick what the wall shows: a party list, a country, a genre or a mood.

    /
    Search
    Enter
    In search: play the top song, or add it to Up next while music plays (Shift: the other)
    Space K
    Play or pause
    N B
    Next or previous song
    ← →
    Back or forward 5 seconds
    Q
    Now playing and Up next
    L
    Lyrics on or off
    M
    Sound on or off
    P
    Pause or resume the wall
    F
    Fullscreen
    D
    Open the TV display (Shift+D: its next mode)
    ? H
    Help
    Esc
    Close

    Party lock (⚙ Settings → Party): guests can search, add songs to Up next and take out their own, and start the music when nothing plays. Skipping, pausing, seeking, the list, the TV display and the settings show a lock and ask for the PIN. The keys follow the same rule.

    ✨ Party setup (⚙ Settings → Party) sets everything for karaoke, a party or background music in one go. A song that YouTube won't play is skipped by itself; the screen stays on while music plays.

    📺 opens the TV display: a second window for the TV or projector with big lyrics (Karaoke), the dancing mascots (Party) or the cover wall (Ambient). On the display: F or a click for fullscreen, 1 2 3 switch the mode, Space and N play, pause and skip.

    Nothing loads from outside until you play a song. Then the video comes from YouTube (youtube-nocookie.com) and the lyrics from LRCLIB (lrclib.net).

    Party setup

    What's tonight?

    Pick one and everything is set. You can change any of it later in ⚙ Settings.

    Search a song…

    Search a song and press + to queue it. Up next plays in order; the lyrics follow along.

    Tip: ⚙ Settings → Party lock keeps guests from skipping songs.

    Party lock is on

    Guests can still search and add songs to Up next.

    No PIN is set. The host holds the button for two seconds.

    A light house-party lock, not security.

    A personal project, for home and house parties with friends. It is not made or meant for commercial or public use.

    Songs play through YouTube's own embedded player and lyrics are fetched from LRCLIB while a song plays; neither is hosted here. Playing music in a business or at a public event needs its own licences.
